parts.latex:
Shoppers are invited to complete an online survey.

What type of sampling is this?

solutions.latex:
In an online survey that shoppers are invited to complete, each shopper chooses whether to take part. The sample is made up of volunteers.

This is a self-selecting sample.

Hence the answer is A.

parts.latex:
There are 960 students at a high school.

Using stratified sampling, 240 students from the whole school are to be chosen for a survey.

If there are 200 students in Year 12, how many Year 12 students should be chosen?

solutions.latex:
In stratified sampling, each year group is sampled in the same proportion as the whole school.

The sampling fraction is
$$\dfrac{240}{960} = \dfrac{1}{4}$$
So the number of Year 12 students chosen is
$$\dfrac{1}{4} \times 200 = 50$$
So the answer is option C.
